aide_version.description: AIDE version being configured (used for header comment only).

db_dir.description: Directory where the AIDE database files are stored.

db_file.description: Filename of the active AIDE database (relative to DB_DIR).

db_url.description: URL (or file path) to the database used at runtime (used by --check).

log_file.description: Path to the AIDE log file for integrity check reports.

db_compress.description: Compression type for the database: 'none', 'gz', or 'bzip2'.

verbose.description: Enable verbose output during database operations (true/false).

db_new.description: Filename used when building a new database (relative to DB_DIR).

reread_conf.description: Whether AIDE should reread the config file on startup.

symlink_count.description: Maximum number of symbolic links to follow during a scan.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for interactive input during init (0 = no timeout).

default.name: All
default.desc: All attributes including inode and timestamps

desc.description: Optional human-readable description of the rule

default.name: Logs
default.desc: Log files (only check for changes in existence/size)

paths.description: List of paths or patterns to include in this group

default.name: FullSystem
default.desc: Default mapping for the entire filesystem

group.description: Space-separated list of file groups (must match group names above)

rules.description: List of rule set names to apply to this group

default_rule_set.description: List of rule-set names (from 'mappings') to use by default (e.g., ['FullSystem']). If empty, no default is set.
